seb c.bio: Seb C is a Vancouver-based house DJ and producer active in British Columbia's electronic music scene. His work is centred on club-focused house music, DJ performance and independent releases. Northern Dial carries Seb C as part of its Canadian electronic and dance catalogue.

shelailai.bio: Shelailai is a Canadian-Caribbean rapper and pop artist who emerged from Vancouver before expanding her career into the United States. Her music moves between hip-hop, pop and Caribbean-influenced sounds, with an independent catalogue built across both sides of the border. Northern Dial carries Shelailai as part of its Canadian hip-hop and pop catalogue.

sonny hendrixx.bio: Sonny Hendrixx is a Toronto hip-hop artist whose catalogue emphasizes lyrical rap, independent releases and collaborations from the city's contemporary scene. Streaming profiles identify him as a Toronto artist, placing his work within the Greater Toronto Area's current rap ecosystem. Northern Dial carries Sonny Hendrixx as part of its Toronto hip-hop catalogue.

sargeant.bio: Sargeant is Calgary vocalist Yolanda Sargeant, one half of the acclaimed lo-fi soul duo Sargeant X Comrade. Her expressive vocals sit at the centre of the group's blend of soul, hip-hop, funk and sample-driven production. Northern Dial carries Sargeant as part of its Calgary and Western Canadian soul catalogue.

comrade.bio: Comrade is Calgary producer Evgeniy 'Comrade' Bykovets, one half of the lo-fi soul duo Sargeant X Comrade. His production combines hip-hop sampling, soul, funk and jazz textures behind vocalist Yolanda Sargeant. Northern Dial carries Comrade as part of its Calgary producer and soul catalogue.
